production.note: US model years 2015-2023. Ford announced the 2015 EcoBoost on 17 July 2014 (source ford-mustang-release-2014). Ford Authority on the 2023 car, which still offers the "Turbocharged 2.3L I4 EcoBoost": "The 2023 Ford Mustang represents the ninth and final model year of the pony car's sixth generation." The S650 EcoBoost (2024-) is a separate record.

body.note: Ford calls the coupe the Fastback. 2023: "Available as Fastback (body code P8T) or Convertible (body code P8U)".

displacementL.note: Ford states "2.3-liter". No opened page gives the cc figure.

aspiration.note: Single turbocharger. Ford brochure: "2.3L EcoBoost: Twin-scroll turbocharger optimized for quick acceleration response".

drivetrain.note: Rear-wheel-drive pony car; categorical, from Ford's description of the Mustang range.

transmission.note: 2015: "6-speed manual or SelectShift automatic transmission" (Ford brochure; KBB: "standard 6-speed manual transmission" and "optional 6-speed SelectShift automatic", source kbb-mustang-specs-2014). From 2018 the 10-speed automatic replaced the 6-speed automatic: The Drive, "Ford's 10-speed automatic transmission will be available in the Mustang for the first time" (source thedrive-mustang-gt-2018). 2023: "six-speed manual transmission or 10-speed automatic" (source fordauthority-mustang-2023).

powerHp.note: Quote, Ford's release of 17 July 2014: "Producing 310 horsepower and 320 lb.- ft. of torque, the 2.3-liter EcoBoost engine fits the bill for a true Mustang powerplant". Ford's 2015 brochure: "310 hp and 320 lb.-ft. of torque" (source ford-mustang-brochure-2015). The horsepower rating never changed: for 2018 "engine output remains at 310 horsepower" while torque rose to 350 lb-ft (source thedrive-mustang-gt-2018), and the 2023 car makes "310 horsepower and 350 pound-feet of torque" (source fordauthority-mustang-2023). The 2020-2023 High Performance Package (330 hp) is an option package, not a separate trim.

weightLb.note: 2015 EcoBoost fastback with the standard 6-speed manual, base curb weight as released by Ford on 17 July 2014 and reported by two independent named-author outlets (weight step 2). Quote, Motor Authority (Nelson Ireson): "Mustang EcoBoost: 3,532 lbs (manual), 3,524 lbs (automatic)". Quote, Torque News (Patrick Rall, source torquenews-mustang-weight-2014): "2015 Ford Mustang EcoBoost Manual Transmission Fastback – 3,532". Consistent with Ford's release (source ford-mustang-release-2014): "the EcoBoost-powered fastback now carrying fewer than 11.4 pounds per horsepower" (3,532 / 310 = 11.39). Ford's specification sheet itself could not be opened.
